lines.text: So the war council grew. Now it had a runaway Measurer, a man from the White, and a hunter with forty stitches in his shoulder.
Six weeks for Hask's warrant. Then soldiers. Two hundred, maybe more.
We beat thirty sellswords. We can beat two hundred.
Two hundred is how it starts. The crown has ten thousand.
Then we can't be a village anymore. A village gets burned. We have to become something the king can't afford to touch.
Then come to the Skeld. My elders want to meet you. The Warm One, they call you. They are freezing, lord. They will listen to anyone who is warm.
Far to the south, nine days later, a white bird landed beneath the Cathedral of the Seven.
Then we stop asking. Prepare a petition for His Majesty. A royal warrant, and a column of soldiers to carry it north.
And in House Corrow, Lady Sabine bought every debt Pell Marrow owed, for twice what they were worth.
Let's see how the zero trades without a merchant.
In Greyhollow, the lamp in the hall burned a little brighter than the night before. It didn't know about any of it.
The Lord Who Measured Zero. Chapter 29, coming soon.
